searchText: Not yet tried! Working on the 4844 milestone doc now, and wondering if there's an explicit commit on the EIP we want to target (and release on the CL side? Previously, we had agreed to include the modulus output for the precompile and the dependency on withdrawals, and specifically excluded eth/68 and disabling blob txn gossip. Is that still what we want to aim for? Similarly, on the CL side, the two only "pending" PRs we had discussed (both now merged) were #3052 (Rebase on Capella) & #3089 (Blob retrieval by root). Should we instead target the latest/next release of the specs? Took a first stab at putting together the milestone tracker for the devnet: https://notes.ethereum.org/@timbeiko/4844-devnet-3 Feedback welcome if you think something is wrong / could be phrased better!
